newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish finmin publishes draft of new tax bill.
newsitem.headline: Irish finmin publishes draft of new tax bill.

text.p: Irish finance minister Ruairi Quinn on Wednesday published a draft of the Taxes Consolidation Bill 1997.

The effect of the draft proposals, when enacted, will be that all income tax, corporation tax and capital gains tax legislation will be available in a single up-to-date act in a coherent, orderly and more simplified format, Quinn said in a statement.
The legislation will also be more accessible and user friendly and will become more coherent to foreign investors and their advisers, Quinn said.
This tax project is the first consolidation of direct tax legislation since 1967 and has been welcomed by tax practitioners.
